title: Minuta 2025-09-25
summary: The minutes of the 25 September meeting confirm the communique's read: four of five members explicitly back continuing the easing cycle under a gradual approach, one stating that 'hay margen para continuar con el ciclo de recortes' and another that the Fed's cut 'abre espacio para ajustar a la baja la tasa en México, sin que se comprima el diferencial'. The doves lean on a widening negative output gap, a peso up more than 10% in the year, an expected persistently weak dollar and a historically long restrictive spell, and argue policy would stay restrictive even with additional cuts. The brakes are visible but do not change the direction: members note the ex-ante real rate (~3.75%) is nearing the upper bound of neutral, one wants the next move assessed meeting by meeting, and Heath (with the dissenting voice in the minutes) calls it 'imperativo mantener una postura restrictiva' until core resumes its decline and asks for guidance without an automatic continuation. Versus the August minutes the Board looks modestly more dovish, since the Fed's cut relaxes the relative-stance constraint that had justified the slower pace; versus this meeting's communique the minutes add no new signal, so the score matches it.

key_quotes.quote: Consideró importante comunicar que hay margen para continuar con el ciclo de recortes bajo un enfoque de gradualidad.
key_quotes.context: A dovish member wants the communication to signal room for further gradual cuts

key_quotes.quote: Enfatizó que la decisión reciente de la Reserva Federal abre espacio para ajustar a la baja la tasa en México, sin que se comprima el diferencial.
key_quotes.context: The Fed cut loosens the relative-stance constraint that had slowed the pace

key_quotes.quote: Reconoció que la postura monetaria estaría próxima a alcanzar el nivel superior de la estimación del intervalo de neutralidad.
key_quotes.context: Remaining room is seen as limited, though the member still supports continuing the cycle

key_quotes.quote: Argumentó que, en este contexto, es imperativo mantener una postura restrictiva hasta que la inflación subyacente retome su tendencia a la baja.
key_quotes.context: The lone hawk (Heath's position) wants to hold until core falls again
